title: Timeouts, Retries and Resilience
introduction: Reliable systems bound waiting, retry selectively and prevent one failing dependency from exhausting everything else.
learningOutcomes: Explain circuit breaking and graceful degradation.

activities.question: Which failure is most suitable for a bounded retry?
activities.explanation: Transient failures may recover; permanent failures need correction rather than repetition.

activities.question: Unlimited immediate retries can make an outage worse.
activities.explanation: Retry storms add load to an already failing dependency.

activities.question: Increasing the delay between retries is called ___.
activities.explanation: Backoff reduces pressure and gives a dependency time to recover.
